matrix_encoding: Rows of field entries [a,b], with rational strings and entry a+b*w. The integral generator is w=(s+sqrt(D))/2, s=D mod 4.
word_encoding: Signed one-based generator indices, in matrix-product order. Empty word is identity. PSL matrices are lifts and relations hold modulo {I,-I}.
certificate_location: results/native_fields_20261021/D*/ contains raw presentations, complete Tietze generator maps, geometric coverage and matrix-to-word certificates. This compact bundle contains simplified matrices and relators, not the full geometric proof data.
enumeration_comparison: Every native form and labelled facet crossing matched exactly against fresh C++ output.
timing_method: Each field has one native warm-up followed by three fresh timed native enumerations, with progress off and GC before each. A fresh C++ enumeration is imported, independently validated and matched form-by-form and neighbour-by-neighbour. C++ times are one run per field. No saved-result reuse.
